purpose: answer-blind first-pass findings from the systematic MAP fidelity audit

findings.detail: The stem asks for two changes that would improve the insulation-design evidence, but the stimulus already states that all containers started at 70°C. Therefore 'Use equal starting water temperatures' is not a change to the stated investigation, leaving only one offered option that actually improves the existing design.
findings.plannedRepair: Keep replication as one improvement and replace the already-satisfied equal-starting-temperature option with a genuine evidence-strengthening change that holds the insulation variable intact: measure each container at several equal time intervals during the test. Then restart the browser-effective Grade 8 Science review from item 1 on the new fingerprint.
